mcp.description: Read-only analytics over a commercial deposit book. Three curated views are published: Deposits (one row per account), MaturityLadder (term deposits with days_to_maturity precomputed) and CustomerExposure (per-customer rollup by currency and product). Base tables are not exposed. There is no write surface and no arbitrary SQL. Balances are a daily snapshot held in several currencies - do not sum across currencies without saying so.

Deposits.description: One row per deposit account, pre-joined to its customer, product and branch. The only general-purpose entity published; the underlying base tables (customer, deposit_account, branch, product) are deliberately not reachable. Balances are a daily snapshot as of the prior business day and are stated in each account's own currency, so sums across mixed currencies need care. Every account in the current snapshot is segment 'commercial'.

fields.name: account_number
fields.description: Unique deposit account number.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Stable customer identifier, e.g. C100000.

fields.name: customer_name
fields.description: Customer legal name, e.g. 'Sterling Supply LLC'. Use a contains filter for partial name lookups.

fields.name: parent_customer_id
fields.description: Parent customer_id when this customer rolls up into a group relationship; null if the customer is its own parent.

fields.name: segment
fields.description: Customer segment. Every account in the current snapshot is 'commercial', so grouping by this returns a single row.

fields.name: industry
fields.description: Customer industry description, e.g. 'Electronics Components'. Ten distinct values.

fields.name: relationship_manager
fields.description: Name of the relationship manager who owns the customer. Ten distinct values. This is the column row-level security filters on.

fields.name: product_code
fields.description: Deposit product code. One of: CD, DDA, NOW, MMA, FX. CD is the only term product.

fields.name: product_name
fields.description: Human-readable product name, e.g. 'Certificate of Deposit'.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO currency code of the account balance. One of: USD, CNY, HKD, JPY, EUR. Shanghai and Hong Kong Central hold no USD accounts.

fields.name: balance
fields.description: Account balance in the account's own currency. The primary measure.

fields.name: rate
fields.description: Interest rate on the account as a percentage, e.g. 3.907 means 3.907%.

fields.name: opened_on
fields.description: Date the account was opened.

fields.name: matures_on
fields.description: Maturity date for term products. Null for everything except CD - use the MaturityLadder entity for maturity questions.

fields.name: as_of_date
fields.description: Reporting snapshot date the row belongs to. There is a single snapshot.

fields.name: branch_code
fields.description: Branch identifier, e.g. CN-001. Prefer branch_name for anything user-facing.

fields.name: branch_name
fields.description: Branch name, usually the city, e.g. 'Shanghai'. Nine distinct values.

fields.name: city
fields.description: Branch city.

fields.name: state_or_region
fields.description: Branch state or region code, e.g. CA, SH, HK.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Branch country code: US, CN or HK.

MaturityLadder.description: Term deposits (CD) that have not yet matured, with days_to_maturity precomputed from the snapshot date. Use this for rollover and funding-risk questions - filter days_to_maturity rather than doing date arithmetic. For example 'maturing in the next 90 days' is days_to_maturity le 90.

fields.name: account_number
fields.description: Unique deposit account number.

fields.name: days_to_maturity
fields.description: Whole days from the snapshot date to maturity. Filter this instead of computing dates, e.g. days_to_maturity le 90.

fields.name: matures_on
fields.description: Maturity date.

fields.name: as_of_date
fields.description: Snapshot date the ladder is measured from.

fields.name: balance
fields.description: Maturing balance in the account's own currency.

fields.name: rate
fields.description: Interest rate as a percentage.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO currency code: USD, CNY, HKD, JPY or EUR.

fields.name: product_code
fields.description: Always CD in this view - it is the only term product.

fields.name: product_name
fields.description: Human-readable product name.

fields.name: branch_name
fields.description: Branch name. Nine distinct values.

fields.name: branch_code
fields.description: Branch identifier.

fields.name: city
fields.description: Branch city.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Branch country code.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Stable customer identifier.

fields.name: customer_name
fields.description: Customer legal name.

fields.name: relationship_manager
fields.description: Relationship manager who owns the customer.

CustomerExposure.description: Per-customer deposit exposure already rolled up by currency and product, with total_balance, account_count and avg_rate. Use this for 'how much does customer X hold' questions instead of reading raw accounts. Group relationships can be rolled up via parent_customer_id.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Stable customer identifier, e.g. C100000.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO currency code: USD, CNY, HKD, JPY or EUR.

fields.name: product_code
fields.description: Deposit product code: CD, DDA, NOW, MMA or FX.

fields.name: customer_name
fields.description: Customer legal name. Use a contains filter for partial name lookups.

fields.name: parent_customer_id
fields.description: Parent customer_id for group relationships; null if the customer is its own parent.

fields.name: segment
fields.description: Customer segment. All 'commercial' in the current snapshot.

fields.name: industry
fields.description: Customer industry description.

fields.name: relationship_manager
fields.description: Relationship manager who owns the customer.

fields.name: product_name
fields.description: Human-readable product name.

fields.name: total_balance
fields.description: Summed balance for this customer/currency/product, in that currency.

fields.name: account_count
fields.description: Number of accounts behind the rollup.

fields.name: avg_rate
fields.description: Average interest rate as a percentage.
